title: Distribution of Prot K (Apostle)
author: Opentrons
materials: Part 2 of 6: Distribution of Prot K (Apostle) Links: * [Distribution of Sample Lysis Buffer](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986) * [Distribution of Prot K (Apostle)](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986-part-2) * [Transfer of DNA Template](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986-part-3) * [Distribution of Master Mix](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986-part-4) * [Distribution of Elution Buffer](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986-part-5) * [Distribution of Prot K (Qiagen)](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6bc986-part-6) This protocol is a translation of the attached json protocol [json protocol](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-04-19/te53ia8/Apostle%20Prot.%20K.json) to python with a couple additional features for control of the blow out location in order to place it near the bottom of the source well: 4 ul Prot K is distributed from a reservoir to the columns of a 96 deep-well plate with a blow out of the disposal volume occuring in a location close to the bottom of the reservoir. The deck layout can be displayed by uploading the attached json protocol to the [Opentrons Protocol Designer web page](https://opentrons.com/protocols/designer/).
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set sample and clearance parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the number of samples (choose a value between 1 and 96) and specify the well‑bottom clearances in millimetres for aspiration and dispense using the parameter fields on the protocol page.

steps.title: Download the protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the provided Python (or JSON) protocol file from the link in the document.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the labware, tip rack, and pipette. Use the supplied calibration tips as described in the support article.

steps.title: Distribute Prot K
steps.instruction: The robot will aspirate 4 µL of Prot K from the reservoir and dispense it into each column of the 96‑deep‑well plate, performing a blow‑out of the disposal volume near the bottom of the reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 4 µL Prot K from the reservoir.
Dispense 4 µL into the target column of the 96‑deep‑well plate.
Blow out the remaining volume close to the bottom of the reservoir.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
